title: Robust LLM Data Selection via Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.36755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. translated_title: 基于内容不变梯度归因的鲁棒大语言模型数据选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36755v1 公告类型： cross 摘要： 基于梯度的数据归因已成为大语言模型（LLM）指令微调中高质量数据选择的重要工具，它通过估计训练样本对模型优化的影响来衡量其贡献。然而，我们发现现有的全局梯度归因方法存在表层形式偏差：即使底层内容保持不变，对语义无关细节（如措辞或格式）的微小改动也会产生高度不一致的归因分数。为解决这一问题，我们提出了内容不变梯度归因，这是一个鲁棒的指令数据选择框架。CIGA首先识别出那些对归因既具有影响力、又在保持语义的表层形式扰动下保持稳定的层，从而降低梯度特征中的格式噪声。随后，它将这些归因信号与语义表示进行动态融合（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出CIGA框架，通过筛选对语义保持扰动稳定的梯度层并与语义表示动态融合，消除了梯度归因中的表层形式偏差，实现了更鲁棒的大语言模型指令微调数据选择。
en_tdlr: CIGA tackles surface-form bias in gradient-based data attribution by identifying gradient layers that remain stable under semantics-preserving perturbations and dynamically fusing attribution signals with semantic representations, enabling robust data selection for LLM instruction fine-tuning.
